Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

GTAPViz 1.3.0

  • New: use GTAPViz from AI assistants (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, …) through a built-in MCP server. Set it up once with mcp_install(); see vignette("GTAPViz_AI"). Every step the AI takes is saved as a reproducible R script (gtapviz_session.R).
  • New functions: mcp_install(), mcp_config() and mcp_serve().
  • Fixed auto_gtap(), which failed with the default settings. With rename_columns = TRUE it now renames REG, COMM, ACTS and Experiment to Region, Commodity, Activity and Scenario, as documented.
  • Updated the help pages of create_export_config(), create_trend_style() and sort_plot_data().

GTAPViz 1.2.0

  • Previous CRAN release.
